below-threshold.body: The order does not reach what the promotion asks for, so no gift was added.
below-threshold.title: {rule}: below the threshold

customer-limit.body: The per-customer limit is reached. The customer is the one OpenLinker recognises, not the channel buyer id.

customer-unknown.body: The per-customer limit could not be checked, so no gift was added.

failed.body: Something went wrong while adding it. You can add the gift by hand, or open the promotion and the run history.
failed.title: {rule}: the gift could not be added

limit-reached.body: No gift was added. Open the promotion to raise the limit and resume it.
limit-reached.title: {rule}: the piece limit is used up

other.body: The promotion did not add its gift to this order. Open it for the details.

superseded.body: An earlier promotion that does not combine with others already gave its gift, so this one did not.
